description: A self-healing script for WiFi interfaces on embedded devices, managing WiFi radio states, BSS queues, and device reboots based on various conditions and counters.
external_methods: grep -w "mgmt bds queue free entries (reserved queue)"

methods.name: onewifi_restart_wifi
methods.description: Restarts the onewifi service and logs the action.

methods.name: vap_restart
methods.description: Restores WiFi access point configuration when a VAP is down.

methods.name: print_wifi_2g_txprobe_cnt
methods.description: Logs the current 2G WiFi probe request and response counts.

methods.name: check_wifi_2g_stuck_status
methods.description: Checks if the 2G WiFi radio is stuck and reinitializes if necessary.

methods.name: print_wifi_5g_txprobe_cnt
methods.description: Logs the current 5G WiFi probe request and response counts.

methods.name: check_wifi_5g_stuck_status
methods.description: Checks if the 5G WiFi radio is stuck and reinitializes if necessary.

methods.name: check_bss_queue_full
methods.description: Checks if the BSS queue is full.

methods.name: wave_driver_restart
methods.description: Restarts the wave driver for specific device models.

methods.name: check_bss_queue_one_min
methods.description: Checks BSS queue status over a minute interval.

calls: grep -w "mgmt bds queue free entries (reserved queue)"
